name: Flying Grimace
description: Flying Grimace is a fast-paced arcade shooting game where players control a spaceship and shoot down waves of flying Grimaces. The game is set in a variety of colorful and challenging environments, and players must use their skills to dodge enemy fire and destroy as many Grimaces as possible. Flying Grimace is a challenging and addictive game that is sure to test players' skills. The game is perfect for fans of arcade shooting games and anyone who loves a good challenge.
